scenes.vo: Someone says you qualify for a free government grant? Stop. Here is how to tell it's a scam.
The FTC lists the warning signs. They contact you out of the blue. They say the grant can pay your bills. They ask for your Social Security number. And they want a fee, often in gift cards or crypto.
scenes.label: 4 WARNING SIGNS

scenes.vo: What to do: never pay a fee for a grant, never share your bank details, and report it at ReportFraud dot FTC dot gov.
scenes.title: WHAT TO DO

items.text: Never pay a fee for a "grant"

scenes.vo: Source: the Federal Trade Commission. Subscribe for a new scam alert every week.

ticker: Real agencies don't call about grants you didn't apply for
